defense_news.title: Poland’s in-development fighting vehicle carries newfound defense-export drive
defense_news.summary: Polish officials hope a new infantry fighting vehicle design will propel the country's weapons-export business.

defense_news.title: Hanwha plans to build armored vehicle carrying a counter-drone laser
defense_news.summary: Hanwha representatives said the vehicle is fitted with a more powerful version of the stationary Cheongwang laser that protects the presidential compound.

defense_news.title: US Air Force seeks air-defense guns to protect overseas bases
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Air Force plans to acquire anti-aircraft guns to protect its overseas bases following Iranian attacks on U.S. bases in the Middle East.

defense_news.title: Sweden to buy HIMARS rocket artillery for around $730 million
defense_news.summary: The Swedish government said it needs more rocket artillery fast, signing off on a $733 million purchase of HIMARS weapons from the United States.
